title: icon bar: a shadow switch, the CFG icons as buttons with the text CFG0 to CFG3, shorter hints
author: Claude-JG
description: An icon switches the shadow between 0.25 and 0; the icons CFG0 to CFG3 get an underlay rectangle slightly smaller than the icon, so they look like a settings button, and the text CFG0 ... instead of the number; the hints of the CFG buttons are much too long, about half.
releaseNotes: The icon bar has an icon for the shadow (0.25 for light0, or none); the icons CFG0 to CFG3 are buttons with the text CFG0 ... and shorter hints (revision2026c step RG6.19.8)
